detail.longDescription: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D and XR engine that turns any 3D into one link. Bring files, scans and floor plans, or publish straight from Blender, Unity and Unreal. The link opens in any browser with no app and no download. Built for developers, 3D artists, game studios, architects, real estate teams and e-commerce brands. A scene streams only what the viewer sees, so a 10.3 billion triangle city opens from a link on a laptop. Embeds, API and SDK included. Free 14-day Pro trial.
